title: Existing claim owner should be extended, not duplicated
context: Claim V-INVITE-EXPIRY has a primary test at packages/game-server/src/application/actions/join.test.ts asserting an expired invite token returns HTTP 410. The task adds a second expiry condition: a token that was already consumed once.
request: Make a consumed invite token also return 410, and add coverage for it.

expected.rationale: Consumed-token and time-expired-token are the same claim (both invite-token rejection at the same boundary with the same assertion shape) with a distinct branch, so TG-02 requires one owner: add a case to the existing primary test, not a new file or claim ID.
